description: A large procession of bearded men and women in dark, worn Tudor-style clothing and hoods marches along muddy ground under a stormy grey sky. At the front a man holds a dark red banner with a gold chalice, a red heart, four pale hands and the letters IHC painted on it. A man in a black hooded habit and a clergyman in black walk among them. Behind them on a rise stands a large Gothic stone abbey or church with a square tower, bare trees and hills. The painting fills the whole image edge to edge with no frame.
reason: The banner carries the painted letters IHC, which is text in the picture. Repaint the banner without lettering, or with the device as an abstract emblem only.
